description: List configured agents (Pi, Pico or ESP32). Returns name, ip, port, online (live /hello probe), type (pi/pico/esp32), version, has_default_key, and last_updated_at (UTC "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", when the agent list was last saved; every sweep saves it). Unreachable agents are included (online=false). The LAN is swept automatically every hour. Pass rescan=true to sweep it now, but only when the user asks to find new hardware: a sweep takes 10 seconds or more. If has_default_key is true for any agent, tell the user that agent is on the insecure default key and ask whether to change it.
name: mcp_agents_list
